title: UTCS Discovery Manifest
description: Published at /.well-known/tax-compliance. Declares the provider's capabilities, transport bindings, authentication requirements, and input profiles. Enables dynamic discovery without hard-coded provider configurations.

utcs_version.description: Version of the UTCS envelope specification this manifest conforms to.

id.description: Unique identifier of the UTCS provider.

description.description: Brief description of the provider and its coverage.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this provider implements. Core tier capabilities (tax-determination, jurisdiction-resolution) are REQUIRED.

endpoints.description: REST endpoint paths for this capability, relative to the REST transport base_url. Each path MUST be an operation in the REST binding. There is no void operation: a void is document_type "void" on POST /tax/determine.

transports.description: Transport bindings supported by this provider.

type.description: Transport binding type. rest, mcp, and webhook have published bindings in this version. a2a is a reserved value: a provider MUST NOT advertise it until a binding is published. No A2A binding is published in this version.

base_url.description: Base URL for this transport. MUST use HTTPS.

mcp_server_url.description: MCP server endpoint. Required when type is 'mcp'.

webhook_registration_url.description: URL for registering webhook callbacks. Required when type is 'webhook'.

authentication.description: Authentication methods supported. Providers MUST support at least one. OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials SHOULD be supported for production.

token_endpoint.description: OAuth2 token endpoint. REQUIRED when method is 'oauth2_client_credentials'.

header_name.description: Header name for API key authentication. REQUIRED when method is 'api_key'.

certificate_requirements.description: Certificate requirements for mTLS. REQUIRED when method is 'mtls'.

input_profiles.description: Input profiles accepted by this provider. 'utcs-standard' MUST always be included.

rounding.description: Provider's rounding configuration. Providers MUST declare this so consumers can verify rounding behavior matches their accounting and reconciliation requirements.

default_method.description: Default rounding method. UTCS default is half-up rounding to the currency's standard minor unit per ISO 4217. This default is consistent with SSUTA Section 324 (the SST rounding rule), which conforming us-sst providers cite as their rounding basis.

granularity.description: Rounding granularity the provider applies. UTCS recommends per-line-item, per-jurisdiction rounding before summation as the default; the provider declares the granularity it uses.

jurisdiction_overrides_applied.description: Whether the provider applies jurisdiction-mandated rounding methods that differ from the default (e.g., banker's rounding, truncation).

conformance_profiles.description: Named tax-standard conformance profiles this provider implements. A conformance profile is a regional or standards-body rule set (sourcing, jurisdiction code systems, document formats, exemption handling) the provider conforms to. This is a provider DECLARATION, not a per-call input: callers never select a profile in a request. The provider derives which profile applies to each transaction and annotates it on the Tax Result via the result-level 'conformance' field.

version.description: Version of the profile the provider conforms to.

badges.description: Certification badges held by this provider.

registry_url.description: URL to the provider's entry in the UTCS public registry.
